description:
Your CRM contains duplicate company records for the same real-world account identified during a routine data audit. One of the duplicate records contains an internal note indicating which should serve as the primary (canonical) record. Consolidate the two Meridian accounts by completing all of the following:

1. Identify the primary Meridian company record by reviewing the internal notes/chatter on each record.
2. Move all 5 individual contacts from the non-primary record to the primary company record.
3. Reassign all 3 opportunities to the primary company record.
4. Archive the non-primary (duplicate) company record.
5. Post a new internal note on the primary company record documenting the consolidation.
6. Remove the 'Requires-Deduplication' tag from the primary company record.
7. Tag all 3 consolidated opportunities with 'Account-Deduped'.

Login with admin/admin at http://localhost:8069
